symbols.name: complex wire count
symbols.meaning: The total number of wires in the complex construction, a fixed number independent of the input length.
symbols.quote: The total number of wires in the complex construction is $W_c$, and the rank-saving argument compares this count with $m$.

symbols.name: central coefficient
symbols.meaning: The number $\tfrac12(|S\cap T|-1)$, the coefficient with which the gather-then-scatter route carries $\xi_T$ into $\eta_S$.
symbols.quote: For an ordered pair $(S,T)$ of triples, $\kappa_{ST}=\tfrac12(|S\cap T|-1)$ is the central coefficient.

symbols.name: extra central wire
symbols.meaning: The extra central wire that holds the sum of all source values.
symbols.quote: The extra central wire $C_*$ gathers the sum of all source values.

relations.quote: The complex construction is a variant of the [subset-intersection network](subset-intersection-network.md).
It takes its scalars from [Gaussian dyadics](gaussian-dyadics.md), so every value it computes is exact.
The complex construction reads its overlaps from [indicator vectors](indicator-vector.md), since $t_S^{\mathsf T}t_T=|S\cap T|$ for triples $S$ and $T$.
